project.description: 150 kW rooftop system on a warehouse, Windsor, Ontario

bidder_holds_on_ec_licence.label: bidder's own Ontario licence
bidder_holds_on_ec_licence.description: true if the proposal states that the bidding company itself holds an Ontario electrical contractor licence. false if it says the electrical work relies on a subcontractor's or partner's licence, or that the licence holder is to be confirmed later.

licence_number.label: licence number
licence_number.description: The Ontario electrical contractor licence number (ECRA/ESA) exactly as written.

wsib_clearance.label: WSIB clearance
wsib_clearance.description: true if the proposal states the bidder has current WSIB clearance.

liability_insurance_cad.label: liability insurance
liability_insurance_cad.description: Amount of general liability insurance the bidder states it carries, in CAD (e.g. 5000000 for $5M).

qualifying_installs_count.label: qualifying installs
qualifying_installs_count.description: Number of completed commercial solar installations of 100 kW or more that the proposal claims.

experience_since_year.label: experience start year
experience_since_year.description: If the count above is given as 'since <year>', that year. Otherwise null.

experience_within_years.label: experience period
experience_within_years.description: If the count above is given as 'in the past/last N years', that N. Otherwise null.

total_price_cad.label: total price
total_price_cad.description: Total all-in price for the project in CAD.

completion_weeks.label: completion time
completion_weeks.description: Committed time to complete the installation, in weeks from award.

panel_warranty_years.label: panel warranty
panel_warranty_years.description: Length of the panel (manufacturer) warranty in years.

workmanship_warranty_years.label: workmanship warranty
workmanship_warranty_years.description: Length of the bidder's workmanship warranty in years.

named_project_lead.label: named project lead
named_project_lead.description: true if a dedicated project lead or project manager is committed and named (or explicitly described as named). false if only 'to be assigned' or a generic coordinator.

crew_described.label: crew described
crew_described.description: true if the delivery crew is described (for example its size or certification).

safety_plan.label: safety plan
safety_plan.description: true if the proposal includes or commits to a site safety plan.

performance_monitoring.label: performance monitoring
performance_monitoring.description: true if the proposal includes monitoring of the solar system's performance after installation. Construction progress reports alone do not count.
